paragraphs.text: The Hall of the Bandit Lord was a legendary hall located on the plane of Kamigawa during the Kami War .

The Hall of the Bandit Lord is a large rough stone building in Sokenzan mountain range that was used by Godo and his sanzoku bandits. During the time of the Kami War, Godo controlled the territory of the mountains towards the south making it the most likely location of the hall.
